interface.name: zsingularity_stage_manager_v1

description.summary: window groups shown one at a time

interface.description: Lets the shell keep windows in groups and show one group at a time. Windows of the other groups are minimized by the compositor and travel to and from a rectangle chosen by the shell, usually the group thumbnail in a strip, instead of the dock icon.

request.name: set_hidden

description.summary: hide or show a toplevel for a group switch

request.description: Minimizes (hidden = 1) or restores (hidden = 0) a toplevel. The window animates towards or from the given rectangle, in output layout coordinates. A rectangle with zero width or height falls back to the regular minimize target.

request.name: set_group

description.summary: remember the group of a toplevel

request.description: Stores an opaque group number on a toplevel. The compositor keeps it for the lifetime of the toplevel, so a shell that restarts can rebuild its groups. Zero clears the group.

request.name: get_group

description.summary: ask for the group of a toplevel

request.description: The compositor answers with a group event for the toplevel.

event.name: group
event.description: The group number stored with set_group, zero when none. Hidden is 1 when the toplevel was minimized through set_hidden and is still minimized.
